verdicts.reason: A is mostly a uniform shrink, so it doesn't really rearrange anything. The yellow circle now sits behind the wordmark and headline instead of in the corner, the text block is pushed right with a big empty left margin, and the legal line and flavour pills are too small to read. Still, the hierarchy, reading order and pill order survive intact. B breaks the layout. The subhead is moved to the top-right corner, far from the headline, so the reading order fails. The pills are scattered and out of order (Honey Rosemary first, Blood Orange stranded below), and the legal text is jammed inside the pink circle. The huge CTA competes with the headline, leaving the right half overcrowded and the bottom-left empty.
